definitions.explanation: Having the ability to act, speak, or think without restrictions or constraints.
The state of being free; the power to act without constraint.

{自由|じゆう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
{自由|じゆう} functions as both a na-adjective (free, unrestricted) and a noun (freedom, liberty).

FORMS:
- Attributive: {自由|じゆう}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun ({自由|じゆう}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ — free time)
- Adverbial: {自由|じゆう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ({自由|じゆう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ — to use freely)
- Predicate: {自由|じゆう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧/⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{自由席|じゆうせき}→自由席：07047_jiyuuseki⟧: unreserved seat
- ⟦{不自由|ふじゆう}→不自由：03596_fujiyuu⟧: inconvenience; disability
- {自由|じゆう}⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧: independent research (school project)
- ⟦{言論|げんろん}→言論：14188_genron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自由|じゆう}: freedom of speech
- {自由|じゆう}⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧: free trade

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自由|じゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to seek freedom
- {自由|じゆう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to act freely
- {自由|じゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧: to take away freedom
